site.name: Velo Client
site.description: Velo Client is a free Minecraft launcher and Fabric client for 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2 and 26.3: more FPS out of the box, 108 free modules, a HUD you style yourself, friends and parties, and 3D wings, capes and auras.

status._comment: downloadsEnabled only controls whether the old local jar in downloads/ is copied into dist/ - real downloads come from GitHub Releases (release.* below). storeLive switches the Velo Coins section from 'coming soon' to live once Tebex is set up on the server; adsLive shows the 'watch ads for coins' card once rewarded ads are switched on.

release._comment: Bump version on every release - the download buttons link straight to these GitHub release assets.

launch._comment: Velo Client 1.0 - out of beta. The countdown on Home / Download runs to this moment, then says it's out.

api._comment: The Velo server. The web Store reads the catalog from here and signs in with a code from the launcher.

plus._comment: Shown before the live price loads (the server's /v1/plus/status is the real one).

counts._comment: Shown across the site - update when modules are added.

seo._comment: IndexNow tells Bing, Yandex, Seznam and others about new pages right after a deploy (deploy.sh pings it).
